text: At the all-false base query oracle, an unrestricted Lean kernel can output true with probability 1/2 after a false history at kernel distance at most 1/2; every represented machine within query distance 1/2 outputs true with probability at most 1/4. This refutes only the earlier sufficient output-and-distance coverage route, not Lean Lipschitzness itself.
title: Adaptive two-query representation fails sufficient coverage
